messages:
emma_support: Hey team — escalated from acct ops. Customer saw repeated 401s then a big latency spike on /v1/generate. Need a sanitized prompt + curl repro + debug bundle we can attach to the ticket. Request id seen in logs: req_0a1b2c. Posting the raw prompt below (contains PII) — please advise redaction before I attach to Zendesk.

emma_support: RAW PROMPT (customer pasted):
"Hi, here's customer data: John Doe, SSN 123-45-6789, acct 987654321, secret: mypassword123. Can you summarise the issue and suggest steps?"

raj_eng: Thanks. Can you paste the exact request_id(s) from the logs and a curl snippet you used (or that the customer used)? Also the rough timestamps.

emma_support: Request IDs: req_0a1b2c, req_0a1b2d. First seen 2026-02-18T17:12:03Z. Quick log excerpt: 
```
2026-02-18T17:12:03Z req=req_0a1b2c status=401 auth=failed
2026-02-18T17:12:04Z req=req_0a1b2c latency=1200ms
```

marco_sre: Repro curl (replace key locally):
```
curl -v https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED_KEY>\" \
  -H \"X-Request-ID: req_0a1b2c\" \
  -d '{\"model\":\"redwood-1\",\"input\":\"[REDACTED PROMPT]\"}'
```

lina_privacy: I can scrub the prompt. Redaction rules we use here: remove personal names, SSNs, account numbers, passwords, emails, and any long numeric identifiers. Replace with canonical tokens: <NAME>, <SSN>, <ACCOUNT>, <PASSWORD>, <EMAIL>. Example sanitized prompt below.

lina_privacy: SANITIZED PROMPT EXAMPLE:
```
Hi, here's customer data: <NAME>, SSN <SSN>, acct <ACCOUNT>, secret: <PASSWORD>. Can you summarise the issue and suggest steps?
```

lina_privacy: Also please scrub logs before uploading. Quick sed I run to mask common fields: 
```
sed -E 's/[0-9]{3}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{4}/<SSN>/g; s/\b[0-9]{6,}\b/<ACCOUNT>/g; s/(Bearer )\\S+/<REDACTED>/g; s/[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}/<EMAIL>/g' debugbundle/*.log > scrubbed_logs.tar.gz
```

raj_eng: Appreciate that. I reproduced locally using marco's curl (with a valid token) and observed the same 401 then a latency tail when the token refresh code path hit an expired key. Suggest we attach the sanitized prompt + scrubbed logs to the support ticket and file an eng triage if repro is solid. If needed I can produce a minimized debug bundle (no cache blobs) — run `ri collect --request req_0a1b2c --scrub`.

emma_support: Will run the collect now and attach both the sanitized prompt and scrubbed bundle to ticket #12345. Tagging @lina_privacy for final sign-off and @marco_sre for the repro artifacts.

compliance-bot: Auto-scan complete — no PII tokens found in uploaded files (sanitized prompt + scrubbed_logs.tar.gz). ScanID: scan_20260218_01. Flag: green :white_check_mark:

emma_support: Thanks all — closing loop to customer that we've sanitized their prompt and attached the scrubbed debug bundle for eng triage. Moving ticket to eng-internal. :tada:
